caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a figure standing on a colorful geometric pedestal made of green, beige, and dark blue sections. The figure has medium to dark skin and is dressed in a yellow long-sleeved shirt and a brown animal-hide vest and skirt combination, with a bear’s face on the front of the vest. The figure’s right hand is raised and holding a bundle of red dynamite sticks. On the head, the figure wears a turquoise and green feathered headdress with a red headband. The left hand holds a beige box labeled "TEL and TEL," which also contains what appears to be a red telephone receiver and several books or pamphlets. A black spherical object and a gold cylindrical object sit at the feet of the figure on the pedestal, along with an extra greenish-beige rectangular form. The background is plain and beige in color, with no additional details.
title: Cigar Store Indian
